metadata.provenance_warning: RewardSpecV1 is an RL training signal only. It is strictly forbidden to rank algorithms primarily by episode return on scientific benchmarks.

reward_equation.formula: raw_total = w_progress * delta_route_completion - (time_penalty_budget / horizon_steps) + r_terminal; total_reward = clip(raw_total, clip_min, clip_max)

components.progress_shaping: w_progress * (route_completion_t - route_completion_{t-1}). Bounded to ~1.0 over full route regardless of map length.
components.time_cost: time_penalty_budget / horizon_steps. Bounded to time_penalty_budget across entire horizon. Discourages standing still without creating speed pressure.
components.clean_success_terminal: +success_bonus awarded only if clean_success=True (arrive_dest and no safety violations).
components.safety_failure_terminal: -safety_penalty awarded if any safety terminal failure occurs (crash_human, crash_vehicle, crash_object, crash_building, crash_sidewalk, out_of_road).

route_completion_provenance.description: route_completion is evaluator/environment-internal telemetry and is NOT part of AgentInput. Only the environment-internal step delta is converted to scalar reward; the agent receives the resulting scalar without privileged global completion state.
